intro: Tourism and money from abroad are the main sources of income.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Beach resorts on Sal and Boa Vista draw visitors. Fishing and wine from Fogo's volcanic soil are also produced.

chapters.title: Water
text: With little rain, Cape Verde relies on desalinating seawater.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Cape Verde makes and sells to the world.
